=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: agents.md ships a contractual "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" section whose `LOG_PREFIX.name=` entries are the authoritative registration list for every stable log prefix the workflow emits; renames are breaking. Every new stable prefix the poller or another workflow starts emitting must be added to that list in the same PR, alongside the descriptive prose the author already wrote.
  Expected change site: agents.md — the `LOG_PREFIX.name=` block near the end of the file (the existing list already contains entries such as `NOOP_RECOVERY_SKIP_FINGERPRINT_CAP`'s neighbours, e.g. `STAGED_SUPPORT_LATCH_RELEASE_SKIPPED`, `SECURITY_PASS_JUDGE_KEEP_FIXING_CAPPED`, etc.).
  Evidence of absence: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23525` now emits `echo "NOOP_RECOVERY_SKIP_FINGERPRINT_CAP pr=${N_PR} head=${N_NOOP_CAP_HEAD_SHA} count=${N_NOOP_COUNT} max=${NOOP_MAX_RETRIES}"` (also surfaced in the changelog fragment `changelog.d/noop-sweep-fingerprint-cap-skip.md` and described in `agents.md`'s review pipeline item 7), but `git diff` shows no new `LOG_PREFIX.name=NOOP_RECOVERY_SKIP_FINGERPRINT_CAP` entry was added to the agents.md prefix registry in this PR. The existing LOG_PREFIX block in agents.md therefore does not recognise the prefix; workflow-log-analysis and any downstream tool that keys on `LOG_PREFIX.name=` will silently skip the new entries (this is the exact contract the section itself states it must not skip), which is a stable-identifier contract violation introduced by this PR.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
